rules.statement: When two or more persons have joined in stipulating for the payment of a certain sum of money, each is ordinarily liable to pay a quota of that money. It is only when the intention of the parties is clearly expressed that each person shall severally pay the whole, that each person becomes bound in solidum.
rules.supporting_quote: When persons have joined in stipulating for the payment of a certain sum of money, each is ordinarily liable to pay a quota of that money, and it is only when the intention of the parties is clearly expressed, that each is severally bound for the payment of the whole, that each person becomes liable in solidum.

meta.parties: Panis Appuhamy v. Selenchi Appu Et Al
